newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil finances "stable but tense" - president.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil finances "stable but tense" - president.

text.p: Preliminary 1996 data of OAO Neftyanaya Kompaniya LUKoil show finances at Russia's biggest oil company are stable but tense, company president Vagit Alekperov was quoted as saying on Monday.

"The analysis of preliminary results of activity in 1996 show that the financial and economic state of the company should be evaluated as stable but also tense," Alekperov told the board of directors according to a company statement.
LUKoil said its preliminary data showed earnings before tax, according to Russian accounting standards, had rise to 3.7 trillion roubles in 1996 from 3.425 trillion in 1995.
Oil production had risen to 58.3 million tonnes from 57.3 million tonnes, and is planned to rise further to 59.7 trillion this year.
